The '''J-37 Jetpack''' was a type of [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The MSM J-37 Jetpack was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Wild Space Explorer's Pack.
